thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — elevated 5xx/timeouts observed from model-serving-runtime (us-west-2). Error spike started ~2026-02-28T14:35Z. Pager: ingrid

ingrid: Oncall here. Seeing gateway 502/504s and model-runner 5xx (SIGABRT) from a subset of nodes. Impacting chat/generation endpoints. Investigating.

mike: Which model/version? Any pattern on input size or prompt length?

ingrid: Mostly long-context requests (>8k tokens) for model v3.1-quant on the affected pool. Errors coincide with memory pressure metrics.

tara: Shipping -> please start short triage: 1) add an emergency route to divert traffic away from the impacted pool; 2) scale up standby pool in us-east; 3) collect kernel logs from node-12.

ops-bot: Runbook step executed: `route reroute --from pool=us-west-2a --to pool=standby-us-west --percent=100`

mike: grabbing logs from model-runner-7:
```
[14:36:12] model-runner: memuse 98% -> OOM? trying to allocate 512MB
[14:36:12] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 12345 (model-worker) score 987 or sacrifice child
[14:36:13] model-worker(12345): ABRT at 0x7ffd...
[14:36:13] model-runner: 5xx exit code 134
```

ingrid: Confirmed SIGABRT + coredumps on node-12. Looks like a memory-corruption/OOM pattern when KV cache + prefetching under long sequences.

tara: Mitigation proposal: 1) disable prefetch/kv-cache mode for v3.1-quant on affected pool 2) enable fallback smaller model (v3.1-mini) for long requests 3) restart the model-runner pods on node-12 one at a time.

ops-bot: Command issued: `kubectl -n inference set env ds/model-runner PREFETCH_KV=false --selector=pool=us-west-2a`

mike: Restarting model-runner on node-12: `kubectl drain node-12 --ignore-daemonsets && kubectl delete pod model-runner-7` — will watch.

ingrid: Restart done. After restart, 5xx rate dropped from 8.4% -> 0.9% in the last 4 mins. Latency back to baseline for most routes.

cust-support: Customer-facing update: CS routed 3 tickets (acct A, B, C) — customers saw timeouts ~14:35-14:45 UTC. We sent interim note: "experienced elevated errors; mitigation in progress".

tara: Also toggled routing policy to prefer caching-on-standby region for heavy seqs. Keeping prefetch disabled until next canary/test.

mike: Collected coredump and uploaded to secure bucket: s3://redwood-coredumps/3962345678/model-worker-12345.dmp

ingrid: Monitoring for 30m. Post-incident actions: 1) reproduce with long-context harness, 2) add guardrail to reject >12k token requests on v3.1-quant until fix, 3) run memcheck / ASAN on quant kernel paths. I'll hand off to the incident PM in 1 hour for postmortem and customer comms.

sre-runbook-bot: Incident state -> mitigation: active -> reduced impact. Suggested followups appended to ticket INC-3962345678.

mike: Quick note: temporary rollback plan ready if we see recurrences — route all long requests to v3.1-mini and re-enable steady state autoscale.

ingrid: Thanks everyone. Moving to recovery. I'll update the channel if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:
